#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Stage the pinned DarwinBoot with the myron iOS 27 streaming path.

This prepares loader source only. It includes the owned-memory handoff and
boot-CPU PAC probe, but does not qualify hardware or ADT/root-volume policy.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess

PIN = '3c75734014cdab0acd9541e88057b7606ee7ae08'
DRIVER = Path('DarwinBootPkg/Driver/DarwinBoot.c')
DRIVER_SHA256 = 'f3815791ad63b87b11ee28118ad1f35a7d0c5258ea70b7b76eda68914fa2b8cf'


def replace_once(text, old, new):
    if text.count(old) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f'loader anchor not unique: {old[:100]!r}')
    return text.replace(old, new, 1)


def patch_driver(text):
    if hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest() != DRIVER_SHA256:
        raise ValueError('DarwinBoot driver differs from the reviewed pin')
    start = text.index('STATIC\nEFI_STATUS\nParseKernelHeader (')
    end = text.index('STATIC\nBOOLEAN\nAdtNode (', start)
    text = text[:start] + '#include "KernelStream.h"\n\n' + text[end:]
    text = replace_once(text, '#define WINDOW_SIZE  SIZE_256MB',
                        '#include "MyronMemory.h"\n#define WINDOW_SIZE  MYRON_OWNED_MEMORY_SIZE')
    text = replace_once(text, '#include "KernelStream.h"',
                        '#include "KernelStream.h"\n#include "Handoff.h"')
    text = replace_once(text, '  *Address = 0;\n',
                        '  *Address = 0;\n  if (WindowSize != MYRON_OWNED_MEMORY_SIZE) { return EFI_UNSUPPORTED; }\n')
    text = replace_once(text,
        '    Candidate = ALIGN_VALUE (Descriptor->PhysicalStart, BLOCK_SIZE) + (Kernel->Base & (BLOCK_SIZE - 1));',
        '    Candidate = ALIGN_VALUE (MAX (Descriptor->PhysicalStart, MYRON_MEMORY_WINDOW_BASE), BLOCK_SIZE) + (Kernel->Base & (BLOCK_SIZE - 1));\n'
        '    if (Candidate < MYRON_MEMORY_WINDOW_BASE || Candidate > MYRON_MEMORY_WINDOW_END - WindowSize) { continue; }')
    text = replace_once(text, '  VOID                            *Image;',
                        '  EFI_FILE_PROTOCOL               *KernelFile;')
    text = replace_once(text, '  Image = NULL;', '  KernelFile = NULL;')
    text = replace_once(text, '  UINT32                          Version;\n  UINTN                           Attempt;',
                        '  UINT64                          Capsule;')
    text = replace_once(text, '  Root = NULL;\n',
        '  if (!MyronSingleCpu (CommandLine) ||\n'
        '      !MyronPacFeatures (READ_SYSREG (id_aa64isar1_el1), READ_SYSREG (id_aa64isar2_el1)) ||\n'
        '      (((READ_SYSREG (id_aa64mmfr0_el1) >> 28) & 15) > 1)) {\n'
        '    Print (L"MYRON27: require cpus=1, address/generic PAC and 4KiB translation; firmware retained\\n");\n'
        '    return EFI_UNSUPPORTED;\n'
        '  }\n  Root = NULL;\n')
    text = replace_once(text,
        '  Status = ReadFile (Root, Request->KernelPath, SIZE_128MB, &Image, &ImageSize);\n'
        '  if (EFI_ERROR (Status)) { goto Fail; }\n'
        '  Status = ParseKernel (Image, ImageSize, &Kernel);',
        '  Status = OpenKernel (Root, Request->KernelPath, &KernelFile, &ImageSize, &Kernel);')
    text = replace_once(text,
        '  for (Index = 0; Index < Kernel.Count; Index++) {\n'
        '    CopyMem ((VOID *)(UINTN)(Address + Kernel.Segments[Index].Address - Kernel.Base),\n'
        '             (UINT8 *)Image + Kernel.Segments[Index].FileOffset, (UINTN)Kernel.Segments[Index].FileSize);\n'
        '  }',
        '  Status = StreamKernel (KernelFile, ImageSize, &Kernel, Address, WindowSize);\n'
        '  if (EFI_ERROR (Status)) { goto Fail; }\n'
        '  KernelFile->Close (KernelFile); KernelFile = NULL;')
    text = replace_once(text, '  FreePool (Image); Image = NULL;\n', '')
    # Copy/validate the capsule while all failure paths can still return to UEFI.
    text = replace_once(text, '  FreePool (Tree); Tree = NULL;\n',
        '  Status = MyronPrepareHandoff (Address, WindowSize, Used, Video, &Capsule);\n'
        '  if (EFI_ERROR (Status)) { goto Fail; }\n'
        '  FreePool (Tree); Tree = NULL;\n')
    start = text.index('  for (Attempt = 0; Attempt < 3; Attempt++) {', text.index('Boot ('))
    end = text.index('Fail:\n', start)
    text = text[:start] + (
        '  // Obtain the final key after all output and capsule preparation.\n'
        '  Status = GetMap (&Map, &Capacity, &MapSize, &Key, &Stride);\n'
        '  if (EFI_ERROR (Status)) { goto Fail; }\n'
        '  MyronExitAndEnter (Map, Capacity, Key, Capsule, ArgsAddress,\n'
        '                     Address + Kernel.Entry - Kernel.Base, Address, WindowSize, Video);\n'
        '  CpuDeadLoop ();\n  return EFI_ABORTED;\n') + text[end:]
    text = replace_once(text, '  if (Image != NULL) { FreePool (Image); }\n', '')
    # A file belongs to its volume; close it first on every failing path.
    text = replace_once(text, 'Fail:\n',
                        'Fail:\n  if (KernelFile != NULL) { KernelFile->Close (KernelFile); }\n')
    return text


def prepare(repo, out):
    repo, out = repo.resolve(), out.resolve()
    if out.exists():
        raise ValueError('use a new staging directory; existing output is preserved')
    head = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(repo), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
    if head != PIN:
        raise ValueError(f'expected DarwinBoot {PIN}, got {head}')
    dirty = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(repo), 'status', '--porcelain'], text=True)
    if dirty:
        raise ValueError('DarwinBoot source must be clean before staging')
    original = (repo / DRIVER).read_text()
    patched = patch_driver(original)
    shutil.copytree(repo, out, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('.git'))
    (out / DRIVER).write_text(patched)
    loader = Path(__file__).with_name('loader')
    headers = ['KernelStream.h', 'MyronMemory.h', 'Handoff.h', 'Handoff.S']
    for name in headers:
        shutil.copy2(loader / name, out / DRIVER.parent / name)
    shutil.copy2(loader / 'Myron27Loader.dsc', out / 'DarwinBootPkg/Myron27Loader.dsc')
    inf = out / DRIVER.parent / 'DarwinBoot.inf'
    inf_text = replace_once(inf.read_text(), '  DarwinBoot.c\n',
                            '  DarwinBoot.c\n' + ''.join('  ' + n + '\n' for n in headers))
    inf.write_text(replace_once(inf_text, '  BaseMemoryLib\n', '  BaseMemoryLib\n  CacheMaintenanceLib\n'))
    report = dict(darwinboot_pin=PIN, driver_original_sha256=DRIVER_SHA256,
                  driver_staged_sha256=hashlib.sha256(patched.encode()).hexdigest(),
                  stream_source_sha256=hashlib.sha256((loader / 'KernelStream.h').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                  handoff_source_sha256={n: hashlib.sha256((loader / n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in headers[1:]},
                  owned_memory_bytes=0x80000000, boot_cpu_only=True,
                  stream_wired_into_boot=True, firmware_built=False,
                  phone_tested=False, desktop_reached=False)
    (out / 'myron27-loader-stage.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
    return report


if __name__ == '__main__':
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument('--darwinboot', type=Path, required=True)
    p.add_argument('--out', type=Path, required=True)
    a = p.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(prepare(a.darwinboot, a.out), indent=2))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile the staged AArch64 UEFI driver, without rebuilding XNU or phone FD."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess

p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
for name in ('staged', 'upstream', 'edk2', 'out', 'clang-bin'):
    p.add_argument('--' + name, type=Path, required=True)
a = p.parse_args()
for name in ('staged', 'upstream', 'edk2', 'out', 'clang_bin'):
    setattr(a, name, getattr(a, name).resolve())
for repo, pin in [(a.edk2, '1f6c853e288ca9c0993a7cf0d0b677b175574fca'),
                  (a.upstream, '04573c510c5fd4892ca6948739389141cc9e05f5')]:
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(repo), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip() == pin
stage = json.loads((a.staged / 'myron27-loader-stage.json').read_text())
driver = a.staged / 'DarwinBootPkg/Driver'
assert hashlib.sha256((driver / 'DarwinBoot.c').read_bytes()).hexdigest() == stage['driver_staged_sha256']
assert hashlib.sha256((driver / 'KernelStream.h').read_bytes()).hexdigest() == stage['stream_source_sha256']
for name, digest in stage['handoff_source_sha256'].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((driver / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest
if a.out.exists():
    raise SystemExit('use a new output directory; existing build evidence is preserved')
conf = a.out / 'Conf'
conf.mkdir(parents=True)
base = a.edk2 / 'BaseTools'
for name in ('target', 'tools_def', 'build_rule'):
    shutil.copy2(base / 'Conf' / (name + '.template'), conf / (name + '.txt'))
env = dict(os.environ, WORKSPACE=str(a.out),
           PACKAGES_PATH=os.pathsep.join(map(str, [a.staged, a.upstream / 'package', a.edk2])),
           EDK_TOOLS_PATH=str(base), CONF_PATH=str(conf),
           CLANG_BIN=str(a.clang_bin) + '/', PYTHON_COMMAND='python3',
           PYTHONPATH=str(base / 'Source/Python'),
           PATH=str(base / 'BinWrappers/PosixLike') + os.pathsep + str(base / 'Source/C/bin') + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'])
cmd = ['python3', str(base / 'Source/Python/build/build.py'), '-p',
       'DarwinBootPkg/Myron27Loader.dsc', '-a', 'AARCH64', '-b', 'RELEASE',
       '-t', 'CLANGPDB', '-n', '4', '-y', str(a.out / 'build-report.txt'), '-Y', 'LIBRARY', '-Y', 'BUILD_FLAGS']
with (a.out / 'build.log').open('w') as log:
    subprocess.run(cmd, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
efi = a.out / 'Build/Myron27Loader/RELEASE_CLANGPDB/AARCH64/DarwinBoot.efi'
b = efi.read_bytes()
pe = struct.unpack_from('<I', b, 0x3c)[0]
assert b[:2] == b'MZ' and b[pe:pe + 4] == b'PE\0\0'
assert struct.unpack_from('<H', b, pe + 4)[0] == 0xaa64
assert struct.unpack_from('<H', b, pe + 24 + 68)[0] == 11  # EFI boot-service driver
report = dict(result='passed', target='AARCH64 UEFI boot-service driver',
              efi=str(efi), bytes=len(b), sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),
              source_stage=stage, command=cmd, full_board_firmware_built=False,
              phone_boot_image_created=False, phone_tested=False)
(a.out / 'loader-build.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the configured myron minimal Mu FD with the staged iOS 27 loader.

Requires the separately maintained, prepared myron Mu board sources. This does
not create an Android boot image or qualify hardware; --payload stages an
offline-checked initial-kernel FAT contract into an output copy of the board.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import zlib
from prepare_loader import replace_once
from firmware_memory_contract import check_source, reviewed_sources

p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
for n in ('mu', 'upstream', 'staged', 'clang-bin', 'out'):
    p.add_argument('--' + n, type=Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--payload', type=Path, help='directory produced by build_payload.py')
a = p.parse_args()
for n in vars(a):
    if isinstance(getattr(a, n), Path): setattr(a, n, getattr(a, n).resolve())
sha = lambda f: hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
pins = [(a.mu, 'e51cd877e31c8fbb322032dc4cb6715e83d25ad3'),
        (a.mu / 'Mu_Basecore', 'cfb93724a06ff86ff5ba971413368a7809ee42a5'),
        (a.mu / 'Common/Mu', 'b8d46c71610318e36a661819e1e3c0b8bdda413a'),
        (a.upstream, '04573c510c5fd4892ca6948739389141cc9e05f5')]
for repo, pin in pins:
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(repo), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip() == pin
board = a.mu / 'Platforms/Xiaomi/myronPkg'
memory_sources = reviewed_sources(board)
profile = json.loads((board / 'staging.json').read_text())
assert profile['profile'] == 'minimal' and profile['probe_stage'] == 0
assert not profile['vendor_modules'] and not profile['raw_files']
stage = json.loads((a.staged / 'myron27-loader-stage.json').read_text())
driver = a.staged / 'DarwinBootPkg/Driver'
assert sha(driver / 'DarwinBoot.c') == stage['driver_staged_sha256']
assert sha(driver / 'KernelStream.h') == stage['stream_source_sha256']
for n, digest in stage['handoff_source_sha256'].items(): assert sha(driver / n) == digest
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(a.upstream), 'status', '--porcelain', '--', 'package'], text=True)
if a.out.exists(): raise SystemExit('use a new output directory')
a.out.mkdir(parents=True)
payload = None
board_package = a.out / 'board-package'
shutil.copytree(board, board_package / 'myronPkg')
board = board_package / 'myronPkg'
for name, raw in memory_sources.items():
    (board / name).write_bytes(raw)
check_source(board)
if a.payload:
    payload = json.loads((a.payload / 'payload.json').read_text())
    fat = (a.payload / 'payload.img').read_bytes()
    assert payload['result'] == 'passed' and len(fat) == payload['bytes'] == 88 * 1024 * 1024
    assert hashlib.sha256(fat).hexdigest() == payload['sha256']
    assert f'{zlib.crc32(fat):08x}' == payload['crc32']
    assert sha(a.payload / 'KernelPayloadExpected.h') == payload['transport_header_sha256']
    shutil.copy2(a.payload / 'KernelPayloadExpected.h', board / 'Library/PlatformPeiLib/KernelPayloadExpected.h')
package = a.out / 'package'
shutil.copytree(a.upstream / 'package', package)
# Preserve the phone's existing explicit selection policy on the new package.
config = package / 'UniXNUPkg/Library/UniXNULib/Config.c'
text = replace_once(config.read_text(), '  "timeout = 10\\n"\n  "rotate = 2\\n"',
                    '  "timeout = -1\\n"\n  "rotate = 0\\n"\n  "default = \\"tools\\"\\n"')
config.write_text(text)
menu = package / 'UniXNUPkg/Library/UniXNULib/Menu.c'
text = replace_once(menu.read_text(),
    '  if (!Countdown) {\n    RemainingMs = HasInput ? -1 : (INTN)Config->FallbackTimeout * 1000;\n'
    '  } else if (Config->Timeout < 0) {\n    RemainingMs = HasInput ? -1 : (INTN)Config->FallbackTimeout * 1000;',
    '  if (!Countdown || (Config->Timeout < 0)) {\n    RemainingMs = -1;')
text = replace_once(text,
    '  RotateMs = Config->RotateSeconds * 1000;\n  if (!HasInput && (RotateMs == 0)) {\n'
    '    RotateMs = DEFAULT_ROTATE_SEC * 1000;\n  }', '  RotateMs = 0; // myron: explicit key selection')
text = replace_once(text,
    'HasInput ? L"Up/Down: select    Enter: boot    1-9: boot entry    Esc: stop timer"\n'
    '             : L"No input device: the default entry boots when the timer ends"',
    'HasInput ? L"VOL+: tap = next; hold 1s then release = select"\n'
    '             : ((RemainingMs < 0) ? L"MYRON: input unavailable; automatic boot disabled"\n'
    '                                  : L"No input device: the default entry boots when the timer ends")')
menu.write_text(text)
base = a.mu / 'Mu_Basecore/BaseTools'
conf = a.out / 'Conf'; conf.mkdir()
for n in ('target', 'tools_def', 'build_rule'):
    shutil.copy2(base / 'Conf' / (n + '.template'), conf / (n + '.txt'))
paths = [board_package] + [a.mu / x for x in ('Platforms/Xiaomi', 'Platforms/HackiOS', 'Common/Mu',
         'Common/Mu_OEM_Sample', 'Mu_Basecore', 'Silicon/Qualcomm', 'Silicon/Silicium',
         'Silicium-ACPI', 'Silicium-ACPI/Silicon/Qualcomm')] + [package, a.staged]
env = dict(os.environ, WORKSPACE=str(a.out), EDK_TOOLS_PATH=str(base),
           PACKAGES_PATH=os.pathsep.join(map(str, paths)), CONF_PATH=str(conf),
           CLANG_BIN=str(a.clang_bin) + '/', PYTHON_COMMAND='python3',
           PYTHONPATH=str(base / 'Source/Python'),
           PATH=str(base / 'BinWrappers/PosixLike') + ':' + str(base / 'Source/C/bin') + ':' + os.environ['PATH'])
cmd = ['python3', str(base / 'Source/Python/build/build.py'), '--no-cache',
       '-p', 'myronPkg/myron.dsc', '-a', 'AARCH64', '-t', 'CLANGPDB', '-b', 'RELEASE',
       '-n', '4', '-y', str(a.out / 'build-report.txt'), '-Y', 'FLASH', '-Y', 'LIBRARY']
for d in ('FD_BASE=0xC6900000', 'FD_SIZE=0x300000', 'FD_BLOCKS=0x300',
          'ENABLE_SECUREBOOT=0', 'MEMORY_PROTECTION=TRUE', 'SHIP_MODE=FALSE',
          'MYRON_MINIMAL=1', 'MYRON_PROBE_STAGE=0', 'BUILDID_STRING=MYRON27_PAC_HANDOFF'):
    cmd += ['-D', d]
with (a.out / 'build.log').open('w') as log:
    subprocess.run(cmd, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
build = a.out / 'Build/myronPkg/RELEASE_CLANGPDB'
fd = build / 'FV/SILICIUM_UEFI.fd'
efi = build / 'AARCH64/DarwinBoot.efi'
assert fd.stat().st_size == 0x300000
menu_bytes = (build / 'AARCH64/UniXNU.efi').read_bytes()
assert b'default = "tools"' in menu_bytes
assert 'VOL+: tap = next; hold 1s then release = select'.encode('utf-16le') in menu_bytes
if payload:
    assert payload['sha256'].encode() in (build / 'AARCH64/Sec.efi').read_bytes()
    assert payload['kernel_sha256'].encode() in (build / 'AARCH64/Sec.efi').read_bytes()
report = dict(result='passed', full_board_firmware_built=True, fd_sha256=sha(fd),
              fd_bytes=fd.stat().st_size, darwinboot_sha256=sha(efi), source_stage=stage,
              menu_manual_selection=True, board_profile=profile, command=cmd,
              payload=payload,
              payload_contract=(board / 'Library/PlatformPeiLib/KernelPayloadExpected.h').read_text(),
              board_source_hashes={str(f.relative_to(board)): sha(f) for f in sorted(board.rglob('*')) if f.is_file()},
              package_changes={str(f.relative_to(package)): sha(f) for f in (menu, config)},
              phone_boot_image_created=False, phone_tested=False)
(a.out / 'firmware-build.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({k: report[k] for k in ('result', 'fd_sha256', 'fd_bytes', 'phone_tested')}, indent=2))

// SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause-Patent
// Position-independent 8 KiB capsule. Runs only in the owned window.
#include <AsmMacroLib.h>
.arch armv8.3-a
.text
.balign 4096
.global MyronHandoffStart
MyronHandoffStart:
  bti c
  msr daifset, #15
  // x0=args, x1=entry, x2=owned start, x3=owned size, x4=fb, x5=fb bytes.
  adr x9, .Largs
  stp x0, x1, [x9]
  stp x2, x3, [x9, #16]
  stp x4, x5, [x9, #32]
  str xzr, [x9, #48]
  mov x20, x0
  adr x9, .Lvectors
  msr vbar_el1, x9
  isb
  // Green: ExitBootServices succeeded, capsule is executing.
  lsr x10, x5, #4
  bic x10, x10, #7
  mov x11, x4
  mov w12, #0xff00
  movk w12, #0xff00, lsl #16
1:stp w12, w12, [x11], #8
  subs x10, x10, #8
  b.hi 1b
  // Flush/invalidate all owned memory, including this copied code/context,
  // and the framebuffer. No stack or external firmware code is used.
  mrs x6, ctr_el0
  ubfx x6, x6, #16, #4
  mov x7, #4
  lsl x6, x7, x6
  sub x7, x6, #1
  add x10, x2, x3
  bic x9, x2, x7
  dsb sy
2:dc civac, x9
  add x9, x9, x6
  cmp x9, x10
  b.lo 2b
  add x10, x4, x5
  bic x9, x4, x7
3:dc civac, x9
  add x9, x9, x6
  cmp x9, x10
  b.lo 3b
  dsb sy
  ic iallu
  dsb sy
  isb
  mrs x9, sctlr_el1
  bic x9, x9, #1
  bic x9, x9, #4
  bic x9, x9, #0x1000
  msr sctlr_el1, x9
  isb
  tlbi vmalle1
  dsb sy
  isb
  // All following code is owned, physical and stackless. No firmware calls.
  b .LPacStart

// Exercise the architectural key registers without disclosing them or changing
// firmware keys before EBS. XNU subsequently installs its own per-boot key set.
.LPacStart:
  adr x9, .Largs
  mov x8, #0x2701
  str x8, [x9, #48]
  mrs x8, APIAKeyLo_EL1
  msr APIAKeyLo_EL1, x8
  mrs x8, APIAKeyHi_EL1
  msr APIAKeyHi_EL1, x8
  mrs x8, APIBKeyLo_EL1
  msr APIBKeyLo_EL1, x8
  mrs x8, APIBKeyHi_EL1
  msr APIBKeyHi_EL1, x8
  mrs x8, APDAKeyLo_EL1
  msr APDAKeyLo_EL1, x8
  mrs x8, APDAKeyHi_EL1
  msr APDAKeyHi_EL1, x8
  mrs x8, APDBKeyLo_EL1
  msr APDBKeyLo_EL1, x8
  mrs x8, APDBKeyHi_EL1
  msr APDBKeyHi_EL1, x8
  mrs x8, APGAKeyLo_EL1
  msr APGAKeyLo_EL1, x8
  mrs x8, APGAKeyHi_EL1
  msr APGAKeyHi_EL1, x8
  mrs x9, sctlr_el1
  orr x9, x9, #0x80000000
  orr x9, x9, #0x40000000
  orr x9, x9, #0x8000000
  orr x9, x9, #0x2000
  msr sctlr_el1, x9
  isb
  adr x9, .Largs
  mov x8, #0x2702
  str x8, [x9, #48]
  bl .LPacRoundTrips
  cbz x0, .LPacMismatch
  // MMU is off. EL0 executes the same physical capsule without firmware
  // mappings or a user stack; a single checked SVC returns to EL1h.
  adr x9, .Largs
  mov x8, #0x2703
  str x8, [x9, #48]
  adr x9, .LPacEl0
  msr elr_el1, x9
  mov x9, #0x3c0
  msr spsr_el1, x9
  eret
.LPacEl0:
  bl .LPacRoundTrips
  svc #0x27
.LPacAfterSvc:
  b .LPacAfterSvc
.LPacEl1Resume:
  cbz x0, .LPacMismatch
  adr x9, .Largs
  mov x8, #0x2704
  str x8, [x9, #48]
  ldp x0, x1, [x9]
  ldp x2, x3, [x9, #16]
  ldp x4, x5, [x9, #32]
  // Cyan second band: EL1/EL0 PAC checks passed; about to branch to XNU.
  // This is a loader milestone, not proof that XNU executed or booted.
  lsr x10, x5, #4
  bic x10, x10, #7
  add x11, x4, x10
  mov w12, #0xffff
  movk w12, #0xff00, lsl #16
4:stp w12, w12, [x11], #8
  subs x10, x10, #8
  b.hi 4b
  dsb sy
  br x1

// Check all address-key pairs, including non-HINT instructions, at both ELs.
// Test several modifiers; a disabled/no-op signing instruction must fail.
.LPacRoundTrips:
  mov x0, #1
  mov x10, #8
  mov x14, #0
  mov x15, #0
  mov x16, #0
  mov x17, #0
  mov x18, #0
.LPacLoop:
  adr x11, .LPacLoop
  mov x12, x11
  pacia x12, x10
  eor x13, x12, x11
  orr x14, x14, x13
  autia x12, x10
  cmp x12, x11
  b.ne .LPacBadReturn
  mov x12, x11
  pacib x12, x10
  eor x13, x12, x11
  orr x15, x15, x13
  autib x12, x10
  cmp x12, x11
  b.ne .LPacBadReturn
  mov x12, x11
  pacda x12, x10
  eor x13, x12, x11
  orr x16, x16, x13
  autda x12, x10
  cmp x12, x11
  b.ne .LPacBadReturn
  mov x12, x11
  pacdb x12, x10
  eor x13, x12, x11
  orr x17, x17, x13
  autdb x12, x10
  cmp x12, x11
  b.ne .LPacBadReturn
  mov x12, #0
  pacga x12, x11, x10
  orr x18, x18, x12
  // Generic PAC must execute; its output is not printed or used as an address.
  subs x10, x10, #1
  b.ne .LPacLoop
  cbz x14, .LPacBadReturn
  cbz x15, .LPacBadReturn
  cbz x16, .LPacBadReturn
  cbz x17, .LPacBadReturn
  cbz x18, .LPacBadReturn

  ret
.LPacBadReturn:
  mov x0, #0
  ret

.LPacSvc:
  mrs x9, esr_el1
  movz x10, #0x27
  movk x10, #0x5600, lsl #16
  cmp x9, x10
  b.ne MyronHandoffException
  mrs x9, elr_el1
  adr x10, .LPacAfterSvc
  cmp x9, x10
  b.ne MyronHandoffException
  adr x9, .Largs
  ldr x9, [x9, #48]
  mov x10, #0x2703
  cmp x9, x10
  b.ne MyronHandoffException
  adr x9, .LPacEl1Resume
  msr elr_el1, x9
  mov x9, #0x3c5
  msr spsr_el1, x9
  eret
.LPacMismatch:
  mov x22, #0
  adr x23, .LPacMismatch
  mov x24, #0
  adr x9, .Largs
  ldr x25, [x9, #48]
  mov x21, #2
  b MyronHandoffReported

.org MyronHandoffStart + 0x800
.Lvectors:
.rept 8
  b MyronHandoffException
  .balign 128
.endr
  b .LPacSvc
  .balign 128
.rept 7
  b MyronHandoffException
  .balign 128
.endr

.org MyronHandoffStart + 0x1000
.global MyronHandoffPass
MyronHandoffPass:
  // The checked C-startup stop calls this after cleaning dirty data and
  // disabling translation again. Display stays usable without new mappings.
  mov w6, #0xffff
  movk w6, #0xff00, lsl #16
  bl .Lband
  ldr x26, [x20, #0x28]
  ldr x27, [x20, #0x38]
  ldr x28, [x20, #0x48]
  lsr x28, x28, #1
  madd x26, x28, x27, x26
  mov x21, #0
.Lreadouts:
  ldr x0, [x19, x21, lsl #3]
  bl .Lhex
  add x26, x26, x27, lsl #6
  add x21, x21, #1
  cmp x21, #8
  b.lo .Lreadouts
.Lpark:
  dsb sy
  wfe
  b .Lpark

.org MyronHandoffStart + 0x1100
.global MyronHandoffException
MyronHandoffException:
  msr daifset, #15
  mrs x22, esr_el1
  mrs x23, elr_el1
  mrs x24, far_el1
  adr x9, .Largs
  ldr x25, [x9, #48]
  mov x21, #1
  b MyronHandoffReported

.org MyronHandoffStart + 0x1180
.global MyronHandoffReported
MyronHandoffReported:
  mov w6, #0
  movk w6, #0xffff, lsl #16
  bl .Lband
  // 16-digit hex rows at half screen height: ESR, ELR, FAR.
  adr x9, .Largs
  ldr x20, [x9]
  ldr x26, [x20, #0x28]
  ldr x27, [x20, #0x38]
  ldr x28, [x20, #0x48]
  lsr x28, x28, #1
  madd x26, x28, x27, x26
  mov x0, x22
  bl .Lhex
  add x26, x26, x27, lsl #6
  mov x0, x23
  bl .Lhex
  add x26, x26, x27, lsl #6
  mov x0, x24
  bl .Lhex
  add x26, x26, x27, lsl #6
  mov x0, x25
  bl .Lhex
  add x26, x26, x27, lsl #6
  mov x0, x21
  bl .Lhex
  b .Lpark

.Lband:
  adr x9, .Largs
  ldr x9, [x9]
  ldr x10, [x9, #0x28]
  ldr x11, [x9, #0x38]
  ldr x12, [x9, #0x48]
  mul x11, x11, x12
  lsr x11, x11, #4
  bic x11, x11, #7
  add x10, x10, x11, lsl #1
  add x10, x10, x11
4:stp w6, w6, [x10], #8
  subs x11, x11, #8
  b.hi 4b
  dsb sy
  ret

// No stack, allocation, external calls or floating point. x22..x28 preserved.
// x0=value, x26=row address, x27=byte stride. 5x7 hex glyphs scaled 4x.
.Lhex:
  mov x1, #60
  mov x2, x26
5:lsrv x3, x0, x1
  and x3, x3, #15
  adr x4, .Lfont
  mov x5, #7
  madd x4, x3, x5, x4
  mov x5, #0
6:ldrb w6, [x4, x5]
  mov x7, #0
7:mov x8, #0
8:mov x9, #4
  sub x9, x9, x7
  lsr w10, w6, w9
  and w10, w10, #1
  neg w10, w10
  add x11, x8, x5, lsl #2
  madd x11, x11, x27, x2
  add x11, x11, x7, lsl #4
  stp w10, w10, [x11]
  stp w10, w10, [x11, #8]
  add x8, x8, #1

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Execute the real capsule in QEMU TCG, including PAC and the EL0 SVC return.

QEMU implements the instructions; they are not replaced with host hooks. This
uses a synthetic entry, 2MiB test window and virtual CPU, not phone firmware.
"""
import argparse,hashlib,json,os,re,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
from elftools.elf.elffile import ELFFile
p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
for n in ('clang','qemu','edk2','out'):p.add_argument('--'+n,type=Path,required=True)
a=p.parse_args();a.out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
source=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'loader/Handoff.S'
original=source.read_text();link=a.out/'link.ld';link.write_text('ENTRY(_start)\nSECTIONS { . = 0x40080000; .text : { *(.text) } }\n')
start=Path(__file__).with_name('handoff_qemu_start.S');results=[]
variants=[('pass','max',original,0x2704),('no_pauth','cortex-a53',original,0x2701),
          ('el1_bad_signature','max',original.replace('  pacia x12, x10','  nop',1),0x2702),
          ('el0_failed_result','max',original.replace('  svc #0x27','  mov x0, #0\n  svc #0x27',1),0x2703),
          ('wrong_svc','max',original.replace('  svc #0x27','  svc #0x28',1),0x2703)]
for name,cpu,code,phase in variants:
 out=a.out/name;out.mkdir(exist_ok=True);asm=out/'Handoff.S';asm.write_text(code);elf=out/'handoff.elf'
 cmd=[str(a.clang.resolve()),'--target=aarch64-none-elf','-Wa,-L','-I'+str(a.edk2.resolve()/'MdePkg/Include/AArch64'),'-nostdlib','-Wl,-T,'+str(link.resolve()),'-fuse-ld=lld',str(start),str(asm),'-o',str(elf)]
 subprocess.run(cmd,check=True)
 with elf.open('rb') as f:
  e=ELFFile(f);syms={s.name:s['st_value'] for s in e.get_section_by_name('.symtab').iter_symbols()}
  assert syms['MyronHandoffEnd']-syms['MyronHandoffStart']==8192
  park=0x411f0000+syms['.Lpark']-syms['MyronHandoffStart']
 q=[str(a.qemu.resolve()),'-M','virt','-cpu',cpu,'-m','256M','-nodefaults','-nographic','-monitor','none','-serial','none','-semihosting-config','enable=on,target=native','-kernel',str(elf.resolve())]
 if name=='pass':
  r=subprocess.run(q,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15);(out/'output.log').write_text(r.stdout+r.stderr)
  assert r.returncode==0 and 'PAC EL1 EL0 PASS; synthetic entry reached' in r.stderr
  results.append(dict(name=name,result='passed',phase=hex(phase),returncode=r.returncode));continue
 q+=['-S','-qmp','stdio']
 log=(out/'output.log').open('w');proc=subprocess.Popen(q,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=log)
 try:
  deadline=time.monotonic()+10
  stream=proc.stdout;writer=proc.stdin;json.loads(stream.readline())
  def call(command,args=None):
   writer.write((json.dumps({'execute':command,'arguments':args or {}})+'\n').encode());writer.flush()
   while True:
    msg=json.loads(stream.readline())
    if 'return' in msg:return msg['return']
    if 'error' in msg:raise RuntimeError(msg)
  call('qmp_capabilities');call('cont')
  regs=''
  while time.monotonic()<deadline:
   regs=call('human-monitor-command',{'command-line':'info registers'})
   m=re.search(r'PC=([0-9a-fA-F]+)',regs)
   if m and park<=int(m[1],16)<=park+12:break
   time.sleep(.03)
  else:raise AssertionError('capsule did not park on fault: '+regs)
  memory=call('human-monitor-command',{'command-line':'xp /7gx 0x411f1f00'})
  values=re.findall(r'0x([0-9a-fA-F]{16})(?!:)',memory)
  assert len(values)==7 and int(values[-1],16)==phase,memory
  (out/'registers.txt').write_text(regs);(out/'context.txt').write_text(memory)
  results.append(dict(name=name,result='passed',phase=hex(phase),parked_in_owned_capsule=True,synthetic_entry_reached=False))
  call('quit');stream.close();writer.close();proc.wait(timeout=3)
 finally:
  if proc.poll() is None:proc.kill();proc.wait()
  log.close()
report=dict(result='passed',cases=results,capsule_bytes=8192,source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            emulator=subprocess.check_output([str(a.qemu.resolve()),'--version'],text=True).splitlines()[0],
            pac_instructions_emulated_by_qemu=True,instruction_hooks_used=False,el1_and_el0_executed=True,
            synthetic_entry_only=True,entry_arguments_preserved=True,
            pac_pass_band_checked=True,test_window_bytes=0x200000,actual_device_window_bytes=0x80000000,
            real_hypervisor_access_qualified=False,phone_tested=False)
(a.out/'handoff-qemu.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Unpack the built myron FD and compare its modules and PAC capsule offline."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import lzma
import re
import shlex
import struct
import uuid
from pathlib import Path
from elftools.elf.elffile import ELFFile

p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
for n in ('build', 'mu', 'staged', 'qemu-test', 'out'):
    p.add_argument('--' + n, type=Path, required=True)
a = p.parse_args()
sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
u16 = lambda b, o: struct.unpack_from('<H', b, o)[0]
u32 = lambda b, o: struct.unpack_from('<I', b, o)[0]
u64 = lambda b, o: struct.unpack_from('<Q', b, o)[0]
align = lambda n, v: (n + v - 1) & -v
modules, raw, nested = {}, {}, []

def sections(b):
    at = 0
    while at < len(b):
        assert at + 4 <= len(b)
        size = int.from_bytes(b[at:at + 3], 'little')
        assert 4 <= size < 0xffffff and at + size <= len(b)
        yield b[at + 3], b[at + 4:at + size]
        at = align(at + size, 4)

def volume(b):
    assert b[40:44] == b'_FVH' and u64(b, 32) == len(b)
    hlen = u16(b, 48)
    assert 56 <= hlen <= len(b) and hlen % 2 == 0
    assert sum(struct.unpack('<' + 'H' * (hlen // 2), b[:hlen])) & 0xffff == 0
    at = align(hlen, 8)
    while at + 24 <= len(b) and b[at:at + 24] != b'\xff' * 24:
        h = b[at:at + 24]
        guid = str(uuid.UUID(bytes_le=h[:16]))
        size = int.from_bytes(h[20:23], 'little')
        assert 24 <= size < 0xffffff and at + size <= len(b)
        assert (sum(h) - h[17] - h[23]) & 0xff == 0
        body = b[at + 24:at + size]
        if h[19] & 0x40: assert (sum(body) + h[17]) & 0xff == 0
        else: assert h[17] == 0xaa
        if h[18] != 0xf0:
            for typ, payload in sections(body):
                if typ in (0x10, 0x12):
                    assert guid not in modules
                    modules[guid] = dict(type=typ, data=payload, ffs_type=h[18])
                elif typ == 0x19:
                    assert guid not in raw; raw[guid] = payload
                elif typ == 2:
                    assert str(uuid.UUID(bytes_le=payload[:16])) == 'ee4e5898-3914-4259-9d6e-dc7bd79403cf'
                    assert u16(payload, 16) == 24 and u16(payload, 18) == 1
                    decoded = lzma.decompress(payload[20:], format=lzma.FORMAT_ALONE)
                    children = list(sections(decoded))
                    # GenFv emits a four-byte empty RAW section for alignment.
                    assert len(children) == 2 and children[0] == (0x19, b'') and children[1][0] == 0x17
                    nested.append(children[1][1]); volume(children[1][1])
        at = align(at + size, 8)

build = a.build / 'Build/myronPkg/RELEASE_CLANGPDB'
fd = (build / 'FV/SILICIUM_UEFI.fd').read_bytes()
assert len(fd) == 0x300000
volume(fd)
assert len(nested) == 1 and nested[0] == (build / 'FV/FVMAIN.Fv').read_bytes()
profile = json.loads((a.mu / 'Platforms/Xiaomi/myronPkg/staging.json').read_text())
assert profile['profile'] == 'minimal' and not profile['vendor_modules'] and not profile['raw_files']
extra = ['SiliciumPkg/Sec/Sec.inf', 'UniXNUPkg/Application/UniXNU/UniXNU.inf',
         'UniXNUPkg/Driver/UniXNUDxe/UniXNUDxe.inf', 'UniXNUPkg/Driver/UniXNURamDiskDxe/UniXNURamDiskDxe.inf',
         'UniXNUPkg/Driver/AdvancedLogDxe/AdvancedLogDxe.inf', 'DarwinBootPkg/Driver/DarwinBoot.inf']
roots = [a.mu / x for x in ('Platforms/Xiaomi', 'Mu_Basecore', 'Silicon/Silicium')]
roots += [a.build / 'package', a.staged]
expected, order, verified = {}, [], []
for name in profile['source_modules'] + extra:
    text = next(r / name for r in roots if (r / name).exists()).read_text()
    guid = re.search(r'FILE_GUID\s*=\s*([\da-fA-F-]+)', text)[1].lower()
    base = re.search(r'BASE_NAME\s*=\s*(\S+)', text)[1]
    assert guid not in expected; expected[guid] = base
    if name in profile['source_modules']: order.append(guid)
assert set(modules) == set(expected)
assert set(raw) == {'fc510ee7-ffdc-11d4-bd41-0080c73c8881', '80cf7257-87ab-47f9-a3fe-d50b76d89541'}
pcd = list((build / 'FV/Ffs').glob('*PcdDxe/DXEPcdDataBaseSec.raw'))
assert len(pcd) == 1 and list(sections(pcd[0].read_bytes())) == [(0x19, raw['80cf7257-87ab-47f9-a3fe-d50b76d89541'])]
apriori = raw['fc510ee7-ffdc-11d4-bd41-0080c73c8881']
assert len(apriori) == 16 * len(order)
assert [str(uuid.UUID(bytes_le=apriori[i:i + 16])) for i in range(0, len(apriori), 16)] == order
for guid, base in expected.items():
    item = modules[guid]; data = item['data']
    if base == 'Sec':
        assert item['type'] == 0x12 and item['ffs_type'] == 3 and data[:2] == b'VZ' and u16(data, 2) == 0xaa64
        entry = u64(data, 16) + u32(data, 8)
        insn = u32(fd, 0); assert insn >> 26 == 5
        imm = insn & 0x3ffffff
        if imm & 0x2000000: imm -= 0x4000000
        assert 0xc6900000 + imm * 4 == entry
    else:
        assert item['type'] == 0x10
        assert data == (build / 'AARCH64' / (base + '.efi')).read_bytes(), base
    verified.append(dict(name=base, guid=guid, sha256=sha(data)))

# Compare the exact final driver's capsule with bytes that actually ran in QEMU.
driver = (build / 'AARCH64/DarwinBoot.efi').read_bytes()
mapping = (build / 'AARCH64/DarwinBootPkg/Driver/DarwinBoot/DEBUG/DarwinBoot.map').read_text()
symbols = {n: int(v, 16) for v, n in re.findall(r'^([0-9a-f]+)\s+[0-9a-f]+\s+0\s+(MyronHandoff\w+)\s*$', mapping, re.M)}
start, end = symbols['MyronHandoffStart'], symbols['MyronHandoffEnd']
assert end - start == 8192
pe = u32(driver, 0x3c); assert driver[pe:pe + 4] == b'PE\0\0'
table = pe + 24 + u16(driver, pe + 20); candidates = []
for i in range(u16(driver, pe + 6)):
    off = table + i * 40; va, size, raw_at = u32(driver, off + 12), u32(driver, off + 16), u32(driver, off + 20)
    if va <= start < end <= va + size: candidates.append(driver[raw_at + start - va:raw_at + end - va])
assert len(candidates) == 1; capsule = candidates[0]
qr = json.loads((a.qemu_test / 'handoff-qemu.json').read_text())
assert qr['result'] == 'passed' and qr['el1_and_el0_executed'] and not qr['instruction_hooks_used']
assert qr['source_sha256'] == sha((a.staged / 'DarwinBootPkg/Driver/Handoff.S').read_bytes())
with (a.qemu_test / 'pass/handoff.elf').open('rb') as f:
    elf = ELFFile(f); syms = {s.name: s['st_value'] for s in elf.get_section_by_name('.symtab').iter_symbols()}
    lo, hi = syms['MyronHandoffStart'], syms['MyronHandoffEnd']; blobs = []
    for seg in elf.iter_segments():
        va = seg['p_vaddr']
        if va <= lo < hi <= va + seg['p_filesz']: blobs.append(seg.data()[lo - va:hi - va])
assert blobs == [capsule]
commands = [line for line in (a.build / 'build.log').read_text().splitlines()
            if '" -MMD ' in line and ' -c ' in line]
assert len(commands) >= 400
def expand_flags(args, depth=0):
    assert depth < 4
    result = []
    for arg in args:
        if arg.startswith('@'):
            path = Path(arg[1:]).resolve()
            assert path.is_relative_to(build.resolve())
            result.extend(expand_flags(shlex.split(path.read_text()), depth + 1))
        else: result.append(arg)
    return result
for command in commands:
    flags = expand_flags(shlex.split(command))
    assert {x for x in flags if x.startswith('-DMYRON_MINIMAL=')} == {'-DMYRON_MINIMAL=1'}
    assert {x for x in flags if x.startswith('-DMYRON_PROBE_STAGE=')} == {'-DMYRON_PROBE_STAGE=0'}
report = dict(result='passed', full_fd_unpacked=True, fd_sha256=sha(fd), fd_bytes=len(fd),
              module_count=len(modules), vendor_modules=0, apriori_entries=len(order),
              source_pe_modules_matched=len(modules) - 1, sec_reset_entry_verified=True,
              capsule_bytes=len(capsule), capsule_sha256=sha(capsule),
              efi_capsule_matches_qemu_executed_bytes=True, modules=verified,
              actual_compile_commands_checked=len(commands),
              phone_boot_image_created=False, phone_tested=False)
a.out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
a.out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in report.items() if k != 'modules'}, indent=2))

schema_version = 2

[board]
# Native-only host builds are permitted. Boot packaging stays blocked until
# PAC handoff, storage, display and iPhone fileset integration are qualified.
example = true
name = "myron"
soc = "SM8850"
soc_source = "sm8850"
os_profile = "ios-27.0.1-24A446-iphone12-1"
description = "Redmi K90 Pro Max; upstream arm64e migration, not boot-qualified"
kit = "myron27"

[components]
include = ["ArmDTPlatform", "ArmCpu", "SoftwareAES", "XnuPrelink", "DarwinBoot"]

[kernel]
defconfig = "myron27_defconfig"
config_fragments = ["arch:configs/common.config", "soc:configs/sm8850.config", "os:configs/ios.config"]
patch_series = ["arch:patches/xnu/series", "soc:patches/xnu-12377/series", "os:patches/xnu/series"]
archives = [
  "build-corecrypto-14.py", "build-corecrypto-14.py --namespace",
  "component:ArmDTPlatform", "component:ArmCpu", "component:SoftwareAES",
  "build-software-aes-bindings.py", "build-mockfs-fixture.py", "build-libpthread-kernel.py",
]

[device_tree]
source = "device:dts/myron.dts"
include_dirs = ["soc:dts"]

[payload]
volume = "MYRON"
# The recorded boot partition is 96 MiB. Leave room for the 3 MiB FD,
# 4 KiB shim and Android header; the current fileset fits an 88 MiB FAT.
size_mib = 88
loader = "firmware"
title = "MYRON upstream 27 migration"
# Mixed fileset TEXT overlaps PRELINK_TEXT; retain safe live mapping attributes.
kernel_args = ["-v", "serial=3", "cpus=1", "use_contiguous_hint=0"]

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the bounded initial-kernel FAT and board transport header, offline.

No old iPad root/trust/Data inputs are reused. The resulting FAT is a bring-up
input, not a desktop system image. Device qualification remains outstanding.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tomllib
import zlib
from payload_adt import parse, validate

p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
for n in ('upstream', 'soc', 'kernel', 'reference-adt', 'out'):
    p.add_argument('--' + n, type=Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--kernel-sha256', required=True)
p.add_argument('--reference-adt-sha256', required=True)
a = p.parse_args()
device = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
assert subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(a.upstream), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip() == '04573c510c5fd4892ca6948739389141cc9e05f5'
kernel, reference = a.kernel.read_bytes(), a.reference_adt.read_bytes()
assert sha(kernel) == a.kernel_sha256 and sha(reference) == a.reference_adt_sha256
magic, cpu, subtype, kind = struct.unpack_from('<4I', kernel)
assert (magic, cpu, subtype & 0xffffff, kind) == (0xfeedfacf, 0x100000c, 2, 0xc)
assert not a.out.exists(), 'use a new output directory'
a.out.mkdir(parents=True)
sys.path.insert(0, str(a.upstream.resolve() / 'scripts'))
from unixnu.profiles import merge
from unixnu.devicetree import generate
from unixnu.payload import write_volume, EPOCH, check_args
config = {}
for f in (a.upstream / 'profiles/arch/arm64e/profile.toml', a.soc / 'soc.toml',
          device / 'upstream-overlay/profiles/os/ios-27.0.1-24A446-iphone12-1/profile.toml', device / 'board.toml'):
    config = merge(config, tomllib.loads(f.read_text()))
assert config['board']['example'] is True
spec = config['payload']; assert spec['size_mib'] == 88 and spec['volume'] == 'MYRON'
line = check_args(spec['kernel_args']); assert line == '-v serial=3 cpus=1 use_contiguous_hint=0'
old = parse(reference)
seed = struct.unpack('<Q', old['/device-tree/chosen']['unique-chip-id'])[0]
dtb = a.out / 'hardware.dtb'
subprocess.run(['dtc', '-I', 'dts', '-O', 'dtb', '-i', str(a.soc / 'dts'),
                '-o', str(dtb), str(device / 'dts/myron.dts')], check=True)
adt = generate(dtb, config, unique_chip_id=f'{seed:x}')
audit = validate(adt, reference)
stage = a.out / 'stage'; dest = stage / 'EFI/UniXNU/Payloads'; dest.mkdir(parents=True)
(dest / 'kernel.macho').write_bytes(kernel)
(dest / 'kernel.macho.adt').write_bytes(adt)
config_path = stage / 'EFI/UniXNU/unixnu.toml'
config_path.write_text('''version = 1
[boot]
timeout = -1
default = "myron27-kernel"
rotate = 0
[kits]
autoload = false
[[entry]]
id = "myron27-kernel"
title = "MYRON iOS 27 initial kernel - no root volume"
type = "xnu"
path = "Payloads/kernel.macho"
args = "''' + line + '''"
[[entry]]
id = "myron27-tools"
title = "Tools / Logs before kernel entry"
type = "action"
action = "tools"
''')
for f in sorted(stage.rglob('*'), reverse=True): os.utime(f, (EPOCH, EPOCH))
os.utime(stage, (EPOCH, EPOCH))
image = a.out / 'payload.img'
write_volume(stage, image, spec['volume'], spec['size_mib'])
for f in sorted(stage.rglob('*')):
    if f.is_file():
        actual = subprocess.check_output(['mtype', '-i', str(image), '::/' + str(f.relative_to(stage))])
        assert actual == f.read_bytes()
fat = image.read_bytes(); assert len(fat) == 88 * 1024 * 1024
assert fat[71:82] == b'MYRON      ' and struct.unpack_from('<I', fat, 32)[0] * 512 == len(fat)
crc = zlib.crc32(fat)
header = ('/* Generated private payload contract; CRC32 is not authentication. */\n'
          '#ifndef MYRON_KERNEL_PAYLOAD_EXPECTED_H\n#define MYRON_KERNEL_PAYLOAD_EXPECTED_H\n'
          f'#define MYRON_KERNEL_FAT_BYTES 0x{len(fat):x}ULL\n'
          f'#define MYRON_KERNEL_FAT_CRC32 0x{crc:08x}U\n'
          f'#define MYRON_KERNEL_FAT_SHA256 "{sha(fat)}"\n'
          f'#define MYRON_R46_KERNEL_SHA256 "{sha(kernel)}"\n#endif\n')
(a.out / 'KernelPayloadExpected.h').write_text(header)
report = dict(result='passed', bytes=len(fat), sha256=sha(fat), crc32=f'{crc:08x}',
              kernel_bytes=len(kernel), kernel_sha256=sha(kernel), adt_bytes=len(adt), adt_sha256=sha(adt),
              reference_adt_sha256=sha(reference), adt_validation=audit,
              transport_header_sha256=sha(header.encode()), kernel_args=line,
              all_fat_files_read_back=True, boot_partition_bytes=0x6000000,
              projected_boot_bytes=4096 + 4096 + 0x300000 + len(fat),
              root_volume_enabled=False, trust_cache_included=False, data_seed_included=False,
              device_boot_qualified=False, phone_tested=False)
assert report['projected_boot_bytes'] < report['boot_partition_bytes']
(a.out / 'payload.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the exact-size kernel-field payload shim; no device I/O."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import subprocess
p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
for n in ('payload', 'clang-bin', 'out'): p.add_argument('--' + n, type=Path, required=True)
a = p.parse_args(); meta = json.loads((a.payload / 'payload.json').read_text())
assert (a.payload / 'payload.img').stat().st_size == meta['bytes'] == 88 * 1024 * 1024
assert hashlib.sha256((a.payload / 'payload.img').read_bytes()).hexdigest() == meta['sha256']
assert not a.out.exists(); a.out.mkdir(parents=True)
source = Path(__file__).with_name('loader') / 'BootShim.S'
obj, elf, binary = [a.out / ('BootShim.' + suffix) for suffix in ('o', 'elf', 'bin')]
subprocess.run([str(a.clang_bin / 'clang'), '--target=aarch64-none-elf',
                '-DMYRON_KERNEL_FAT_BYTES=' + str(meta['bytes']), '-c', str(source), '-o', str(obj)], check=True)
subprocess.run([str(a.clang_bin / 'ld.lld'), '--build-id=none', '-Ttext=0', '-e', '_Head', str(obj), '-o', str(elf)], check=True)
subprocess.run([str(a.clang_bin / 'llvm-objcopy'), '-O', 'binary', str(elf), str(binary)], check=True)
b = binary.read_bytes()
assert len(b) == 4096 and b[56:60] == b'ARM\x64'
assert struct.unpack_from('<QQQ', b, 8) == (0, 0x301000 + meta['bytes'], 0xa)
report = dict(result='passed', shim_bytes=len(b), shim_sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),
              source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), payload_bytes=meta['bytes'],
              payload_sha256=meta['sha256'], arm_image_size=0x301000 + meta['bytes'], phone_tested=False)
(a.out / 'shim-build.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))

/* SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause-Patent
 * MYRON diagnostic FD relocation shim. Optional MYRON_IMAGE_HEADER produces
 * a direct-entry ARM64 Image prefix, not a phone-qualified Android container.
 * Entry requires EL1/EL2, MMU and D-cache disabled.
 * FD follows _Payload and must be exactly 3 MiB. Optional R48 FAT follows FD,
 * stays at its bootloader-loaded address, and is never copied by this shim.
 * Preserve stock SEC at c6800000-c6900000; the board validates its service tables.
 */
.section .text
.global _Head
.global _Payload
#define MYRON_IMAGE_HEADER 1
#define MYRON_KERNEL_FAT 1
#ifndef MYRON_KERNEL_FAT_BYTES
#error Define the exact generated payload size
#endif
#if MYRON_KERNEL_FAT_BYTES < 0x4000000 || MYRON_KERNEL_FAT_BYTES > 0x5c00000 || (MYRON_KERNEL_FAT_BYTES & 0xfffff)
#error Payload must be 64 to 92 MiB in MiB units
#endif
_Head:
#if MYRON_IMAGE_HEADER
  b _Start
  nop
  .quad 0 /* text_offset is a relative offset, NOT FD_BASE. */
  .quad ((_Payload - _Head + 0x300000 + MYRON_KERNEL_FAT_BYTES + 0xfff) & ~0xfff)
  .quad 0xa /* 4 KiB pages; any suitable 2 MiB aligned load base. */
  .quad 0, 0, 0
  .ascii "ARM\x64"
  .long 0 /* Direct Linux-protocol entry; no fake PE/COFF EFI stub. */
#endif
_Start:
  mov x19, x0
  mov x20, x1
  mov x21, x2
  mov x22, x3
  mrs x8, CurrentEL
  cmp x8, #4
  b.eq 1f
  cmp x8, #8
  b.ne _Stop
  mrs x8, sctlr_el2
  b 2f
1:
  mrs x8, sctlr_el1
2:
  tbnz x8, #0, _Stop
  tbnz x8, #2, _Stop
  adr x4, _Payload
  ldr x5, =0xC6900000
  ldr x6, =0x00300000
  cmp x4, x5
  b.eq _Entry
  adds x7, x4, x6
  b.cs _Stop
  add x8, x5, x6
  cmp x7, x5
  b.ls _Copy
  cmp x4, x8
  b.lo _Stop
_Copy:
  ldp x2, x3, [x4], #16
  stp x2, x3, [x5], #16
  subs x6, x6, #16
  b.ne _Copy
_Entry:
  dsb sy
  ic iallu
  dsb sy
  isb
  mov x0, x19
  mov x1, x20
  mov x2, x21
  mov x3, x22
#if MYRON_KERNEL_FAT
  /* Private shim-to-SEC metadata, captured before SEC changes registers.
   * SEC must validate every range before dereferencing this appended FAT. */
  ldr x4, =0x383430504e52594d /* MYRNP048, little endian */
  adr x5, _Payload
  add x5, x5, #0x300, lsl #12
  ldr x6, =MYRON_KERNEL_FAT_BYTES
  adr x7, _Head
  ldr x8, =0xC6900000
  br x8
#else
  ldr x5, =0xC6900000
  br x5
#endif
_Stop:
  wfe
  b _Stop
.ltorg
#if MYRON_KERNEL_FAT
.balign 4096
#else
.balign 16
#endif
_Payload:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bind audited components into an experimental Android v4 entry probe.

Offline only: no flashing, signing, root volume or device qualification.
The private baseline supplies the already reviewed device boot header.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import subprocess
import zlib
from firmware_memory_contract import check_hashes, check_source


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def report(path):
    value = json.loads(path.read_text())
    assert value.get('result') == 'passed', path
    return value


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for n in ('baseline', 'firmware', 'payload', 'shim', 'host-report',
              'shim-report', 'shim-qemu-report', 'out'):
        p.add_argument('--' + n, type=Path, required=True)
    p.add_argument('--baseline-sha256', required=True)
    a = p.parse_args()
    baseline = a.baseline.read_bytes()
    assert sha(baseline) == a.baseline_sha256
    assert len(baseline) >= 4096 and baseline[:8] == b'ANDROID!'
    u32 = lambda b, o: struct.unpack_from('<I', b, o)[0]
    assert u32(baseline, 40) == 4 and u32(baseline, 20) == 1584
    assert u32(baseline, 12) == u32(baseline, 1580) == 0
    assert not any(baseline[24:40]) and baseline[-64:-60] != b'AVBf'
    fw = report(a.firmware / 'firmware-build.json')
    check_hashes(fw['board_source_hashes'])
    check_source(a.firmware / 'board-package/myronPkg')
    fv = report(a.firmware / 'firmware-verification.json')
    payload = report(a.payload / 'payload.json')
    shim = report(a.shim / 'shim-build.json')
    host = report(a.host_report)
    st = report(a.shim_report)
    sq = json.loads(a.shim_qemu_report.read_text())
    fat = (a.payload / 'payload.img').read_bytes()
    fd = (a.firmware / 'Build/myronPkg/RELEASE_CLANGPDB/FV/SILICIUM_UEFI.fd').read_bytes()
    code = (a.shim / 'BootShim.bin').read_bytes()
    assert len(fd) == fw['fd_bytes'] == fv['fd_bytes'] == 0x300000
    assert sha(fd) == fw['fd_sha256'] == fv['fd_sha256']
    assert fv['efi_capsule_matches_qemu_executed_bytes']
    assert fw['payload'] == payload
    assert len(fat) == payload['bytes'] == shim['payload_bytes'] == 88 * 1024 * 1024
    assert sha(fat) == payload['sha256'] == shim['payload_sha256']
    assert f'{zlib.crc32(fat):08x}' == payload['crc32']
    header = (a.payload / 'KernelPayloadExpected.h').read_bytes()
    assert sha(header) == payload['transport_header_sha256']
    assert header.decode() == fw['payload_contract']
    assert (a.firmware / 'board-package/myronPkg/Library/PlatformPeiLib/KernelPayloadExpected.h').read_bytes() == header
    assert len(code) == shim['shim_bytes'] == 4096
    assert sha(code) == shim['shim_sha256'] == st['shim_sha256'] == sq['shim_sha256']
    assert len(st['cases']) == 10
    assert [(x['el'], x['passed']) for x in sq['cases']] == [(1, True), (2, True)]
    assert code[56:60] == b'ARMd'
    assert struct.unpack_from('<Q', code, 16)[0] == shim['arm_image_size'] == len(code + fd + fat)
    assert host['kernel_sha256'] == payload['kernel_sha256']
    assert host['adt_sha256'] == payload['adt_sha256'] and host['adt_bytes_checked_at_handoff']
    assert host['scenario_count'] == 65 and host['byte_equality_at_handoff']
    assert host['driver_sha256'] == fw['source_stage']['driver_staged_sha256']
    assert host['stream_source_sha256'] == fw['source_stage']['stream_source_sha256']
    assert not payload['root_volume_enabled'] and not payload['trust_cache_included']
    assert not payload['data_seed_included']
    boot_header = bytearray(baseline[:4096])
    struct.pack_into('<I', boot_header, 8, len(code + fd + fat))
    data = boot_header + code + fd + fat
    assert data[:8] == baseline[:8] and data[12:4096] == baseline[12:4096]
    assert len(data) == payload['projected_boot_bytes'] < payload['boot_partition_bytes'] == 0x6000000
    assert len(data) % 4096 == 0
    assert not a.out.exists(), 'use a new output directory'
    a.out.mkdir(parents=True)
    target = a.out / 'myron-ios27-entry-probe.img'
    target.write_bytes(data)
    checks = {}
    for name, digest in [('kernel.macho', payload['kernel_sha256']),
                         ('kernel.macho.adt', payload['adt_sha256'])]:
        path = 'EFI/UniXNU/Payloads/' + name
        actual = subprocess.check_output(['mtype', '-i', str(target) + '@@3153920', '::/' + path])
        assert sha(actual) == digest
        checks[path] = digest
    path = 'EFI/UniXNU/unixnu.toml'
    actual = subprocess.check_output(['mtype', '-i', str(target) + '@@3153920', '::/' + path])
    assert actual == (a.payload / 'stage' / path).read_bytes()
    checks[path] = sha(actual)
    result = dict(result='passed', image=target.name, bytes=len(data), sha256=sha(data),
                  android_header_version=4, header_changes=['kernel_size'],
                  baseline_sha256=sha(baseline), fd_sha256=sha(fd), shim_sha256=sha(code),
                  payload_sha256=sha(fat), capsule_sha256=fv['capsule_sha256'],
                  fat_offset=3153920, all_embedded_files_read_back=checks,
                  boot_partition_bytes=payload['boot_partition_bytes'],
                  partition_headroom_bytes=payload['boot_partition_bytes'] - len(data),
                  root_volume_enabled=False, phone_tested=False, desktop_reached=False,
                  intended_use='experimental temporary fastboot boot; initial kernel only',
                  screen_milestones={'green': 'EBS passed, capsule executing',
                                     'cyan_second_band': 'PAC passed, before XNU branch; not proof of XNU entry'})
    (a.out / 'entry-probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile the existing myron transport for arm64e; never bind legacy ABI offsets."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import subprocess
import tomllib


def module(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    result = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(result)
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--tree', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--upstream', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--out', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    tree, upstream, out = args.tree.resolve(), args.upstream.resolve(), args.out.resolve()
    here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    profile = tomllib.loads((here/'upstream-overlay/profiles/os/ios-27.0.1-24A446-iphone12-1/profile.toml').read_text())
    os.environ.update(UNIXNU_XNU_ARCH='arm64e', UNIXNU_IOS_VERSION='27.0')
    builder = module('driver_builder', upstream/'scripts/build-sheng-source-drivers.py')
    target = module('myron_target', upstream/'scripts/kernel_target.py')
    headers = module('storage_headers', upstream/'scripts/prepare-storage-headers.py')
    storage_pin = next(s['commit'] for s in profile['source'] if s['name']=='IOStorageFamily')
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    header_report = headers.prepare(tree/'refer/IOStorageFamily', storage_pin, out/'headers')
    recipe = tree/'build/xnu/ios-obj/DEVELOPMENT_ARM64_BCM2837/iokit/DEVELOPMENT/IOPlatformExpert.cpo.json'
    record = json.loads(recipe.read_text().strip().rstrip(','))
    target.check_object((Path(record['directory'])/'IOPlatformExpert.cpo').read_bytes(), 'kernel recipe')
    source = here.parent/'sm8850/drivers/NativeUfs/MyronUfsProbe.cpp'
    pins = json.loads((source.parent/'UPSTREAM.json').read_text())
    for entry in pins['files']:
        path = source.parent/'upstream'/entry['path']
        if path.is_file():
            data = path.read_bytes()
            if hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(data)).encode()+b'\0'+data).hexdigest()!=entry['sha']:
                raise ValueError(f'Vendored UFS source changed: {path}')
    from prepare_ufs_transport import stage
    transport_patch = stage(source.parent, out/'ufs-source')
    source = out/'ufs-source/MyronUfsProbe.cpp'
    output = out/'MyronUfsProbe.o'
    command = builder.compile_command(record, source, output,
        ['-I', str(out/'headers/include')],
        ['-DMYRON_ROOT_POLICY=0', '-Wno-missing-designated-field-initializers', '-Wno-error'])
    (out/'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(command, indent=2)+'\n')
    with (out/'compile.log').open('w') as log:
        subprocess.run(command, cwd=record['directory'], stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
    target.check_object(output.read_bytes(), 'myron UFS source')
    dependencies = {}
    deptext = output.with_suffix('.d').read_text().replace('\\\n', '')
    for name in shlex.split(deptext.split(':', 1)[1]):
        path = Path(name)
        if not path.is_absolute(): path = Path(record['directory'])/path
        dependencies[str(path.resolve())] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    imports = sorted(builder.nm(output, '-u'))
    report = dict(target=target.TRIPLE, compile_pass=True, source_pin=pins['commit'],
        storage_headers=header_report, transport_patch=transport_patch,
        object_sha256=hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        undefined_symbols=imports, dependencies=dependencies,
        legacy_absolute_bindings_added=False, kernel_linked=False, root_published=False,
        runtime_qualified=False)
    (out/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n')
    print('PASS myron UFS arm64e source compilation; family binding remains pending', flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__': main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Stage pinned UFS sources with local DMA and verified-storage VM fixes.

Vendored bytes and UPSTREAM.json remain unchanged. Both native builders and
the offline command tests consume this same transformation.
"""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil


PIN = 'cc33d261bcda90c38bbbea725c32f34a4f71c844'
COMMAND_BLOB = '996304d7d22b74c0f2fcaad2d14676f480bc19c1'
DRIVER_BLOB = '30d278363604a69ebd376bfc5ef3589a95cc2fd3'


def blob(data):
    return hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(data)).encode() + b'\0' + data).hexdigest()


def replace_once(text, before, after):
    if text.count(before) != 1:
        raise ValueError('UFS local patch context changed')
    return text.replace(before, after, 1)


def patch_commands(data):
    if blob(data) != COMMAND_BLOB:
        raise ValueError('Unreviewed RootCommands.h input')
    text = data.decode()
    text = replace_once(text, 'static bool hostClearUcd (void)\n{',
        'static bool hostDmaWritable (void)\n{')
    text = replace_once(text,
        '  uint32_t *words = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t *> (gHost.virt + kUcdOffset);',
        '  return true;\n}\n\nstatic bool hostClearUcd (void)\n{\n'
        '  if (!hostDmaWritable ()) return false;\n'
        '  uint32_t *words = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t *> (gHost.virt + kUcdOffset);')
    text = replace_once(text, '  if (!gHost.ready || !src || !blocks ||',
        '  if (!src || !blocks ||')
    text = replace_once(text,
        '  IOLockLock (gHost.lock);\n  gRootDiagnostic.lba = lba;\n'
        '  memcpy (gHost.virt + kDataOffset, src, blocks * 4096U);',
        '  IOLockLock (gHost.lock);\n'
        '  // Recheck ownership after waiting for a previous command. No CPU\n'
        '  // store may touch DMA quarantined by a timeout, busy slot or fault.\n'
        '  if (!gHost.ready || !hostDmaWritable ()) {\n'
        '    IOLockUnlock (gHost.lock);\n'
        '    return kIOReturnNotReady;\n'
        '  }\n'
        '  gRootDiagnostic.lba = lba;\n'
        '  memcpy (gHost.virt + kDataOffset, src, blocks * 4096U);')
    return text.encode()


def patch_verified_vm(data):
    """Use the pinned XNU kernel interfaces without exposing VM internals."""
    if blob(data) != DRIVER_BLOB:
        raise ValueError('Unreviewed NativeUfs.cpp input')
    text = data.decode()
    text = replace_once(text, '#include <vm/vm_kern.h>',
        '#include <vm/vm_kern.h>\n'
        '#if NATIVE_VERIFIED_BLOCK\n'
        '#include <vm/vm_kern_xnu.h>\n'
        '#include <mach/vm_map.h>\n'
        '#endif')
    text = replace_once(text,
        'vm_map_protect (kernel_map, verifiedStorage, verifiedStorage + verifiedStorageBytes,\n'
        '                      VM_PROT_READ, TRUE)',
        'vm_protect (kernel_map, verifiedStorage, verifiedStorageBytes,\n'
        '                  TRUE, VM_PROT_READ)')
    return text.encode()


def stage(source, destination):
    source, destination = Path(source).resolve(), Path(destination).resolve()
    if source == destination or source in destination.parents:
        raise ValueError('Staging must not modify the vendored tree')
    pins = json.loads((source / 'UPSTREAM.json').read_text())
    if pins['commit'] != PIN:
        raise ValueError('Unreviewed NativeUfs revision')
    verified = {}
    for entry in pins['files']:
        path = source / 'upstream' / entry['path']
        if path.is_file():
            if blob(path.read_bytes()) != entry['sha']:
                raise ValueError(f'Vendored UFS source changed: {path}')
            verified[entry['path']] = entry['sha']
        elif not entry['path'].startswith('tests/') and path.suffix in ('.h', '.cpp'):
            raise ValueError(f'Vendored UFS source is missing: {path}')
    original = (source / 'upstream/RootCommands.h').read_bytes()
    patched = patch_commands(original)
    driver_original = (source / 'upstream/NativeUfs.cpp').read_bytes()
    driver_patched = patch_driver(driver_original)
    # Empty staging avoids accidentally consuming stale headers from a prior run.
    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if any(destination.iterdir()):
        raise ValueError('UFS staging directory must be empty')
    shutil.copytree(source, destination, dirs_exist_ok=True)
    (destination / 'upstream/RootCommands.h').write_bytes(patched)
    (destination / 'upstream/NativeUfs.cpp').write_bytes(driver_patched)
    report = dict(upstream_commit=PIN, verified_blobs=verified,
        local_patch='check write DMA ownership under the command lock before memcpy',
        original_sha256=hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest(),
        patched_sha256=hashlib.sha256(patched).hexdigest(), vendored_source_unchanged=True)
    report['verified_vm_patch'] = dict(
        original_sha256=hashlib.sha256(driver_original).hexdigest(),
        patched_sha256=hashlib.sha256(driver_patched).hexdigest(),
        protection='vm_protect: byte length, set_maximum=TRUE, VM_PROT_READ')
    report['progress_observer'] = 'compiled only with XNU_BOOT_PROGRESS; no weak PAC import when disabled'
    (destination / 'local-patch.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
    return report


def patch_driver(data):
    text = patch_verified_vm(data).decode()
    # The optional observer is absent in this board's XNU_BOOT_PROGRESS=0
    # kernel. arm64e cannot link its authenticated undefined weak pointer.
    # Use the same compile-time feature guard as the kernel, without a stub.
    guard = '#if defined(XNU_BOOT_PROGRESS) && XNU_BOOT_PROGRESS\n'
    text = replace_once(text,
        'void boot_progress_poll (void) __attribute__((weak));',
        guard + 'void boot_progress_poll (void) __attribute__((weak));\n#endif')
    text = replace_once(text,
        '      if (boot_progress_poll) boot_progress_poll ();',
        guard + '      if (boot_progress_poll) boot_progress_poll ();\n#endif')
    return text.encode()

    text = replace_once(text, 'subprocess.Popen(command, stdout=log, stderr=log)',

                process.stdin.write((command + '\\n').encode())
                deadline = time.monotonic() + 5

    qtest.write_text(text)
    run([sys.executable, str(qtest), '--output', str(out / 'qemu'),

    assert arm64_report['source_sha256']['RootCommands.h'] == patch_report['patched_sha256']
    assert (native / 'upstream/RootCommands.h').read_bytes() == original
    report = dict(pass_=True, transport_patch=patch_report, verified_root_commit=VR_PIN,
        verified_root_blobs=VR_BLOBS, sanitizer_suites=list(HOST_TESTS),
        quarantine_regression=dict(before_mutates_dma=3, after_preserves_dma=3),

        commands=commands, sanitizers='ASan+UBSan; leak detection disabled for sandbox ptrace',
        test_sha256={p.name: sha(p) for p in (Path(__file__), regression)},

# UFS transport progress — 2026-11-05

The production command path now checks DMA ownership while holding the command
lock, before copying a write payload. Previously a caller could pass the ready
check, wait behind a request that timed out, then modify the quarantined buffer.
An already busy slot or fatal controller status also allowed that early copy.
All three cases are reproduced against the original source and preserve the
entire DMA allocation after the fix; no MMIO write or cache operation occurs.

`prepare_ufs_transport.py` applies this explicit local change to a separate
build tree. Both UFS native builders use it. Vendored source and upstream blob
pins remain unchanged. Unknown, modified and already patched command inputs
are rejected. The patched RootCommands.h SHA256 is
`f0e9bd5248f2a7cd4f4ca80c1756c8002aecaa938c97777a071aa9b8d9bb3826`.

Offline validation passed:

- Seven ASan/UBSan suites: commands, layout, window reads, diagnostics, media
  publication bookkeeping, SMMU takeover planning and completion polling.
  Leak checking is disabled because the Linux sandbox uses ptrace.
- Actual QEMU generic UFS controller: DMA at 0x40010000 and 0x8cb5e9000,
  NOP/query/read, 4 KiB and 128 KiB payloads, GPT/manifest parsing, RSA-3072 owner
  signature and block verification, partial tails and corruption rejection.
  Writes and cache synchronization touch only the two synthetic allowed windows.
- Five ARM64 EL1 executions with the MMU/caches enabled and distinct virtual
  and physical DMA addresses: low, high, inner-shareable high, truncated-high
  address rejection and virtual-address-as-physical rejection. The last two
  time out and quarantine without resubmission. Actual production volatile
  MMIO, DC CIVAC/DC IVAC and barriers are compiled into the test guest.
- Nine existing dormant-link metadata tests pass.

Reproduce with checkouts of NativeUfs-myron
`cc33d261bcda90c38bbbea725c32f34a4f71c844` and VerifiedRoot
`974f043d0c71ba2e60331483a41c6c6d35274ee3`, QEMU 10 with UFS support,
Clang/LLD 19, GCC with ASan/UBSan, and OpenSSL 3 development headers:

```sh
python3 device/myron27/tests/check_ufs_transport.py \
  --transport-checkout /path/to/NativeUfs-myron \
  --verified-root /path/to/VerifiedRoot \
  --openssl-prefix /usr --out /private/path/ufs-transport
```

The runner verifies fixture Git blobs, uses qtest pipes on Linux, adapts only
host compiler flags/portable integer literals and records all commands/hashes.
Keep generated images, keys, logs and reports outside the public repository.

This is transport qualification against synthetic media on a generic controller,
not an XNU root mount. Qualcomm SMMU/PHY/power/cache behavior, native IOMedia
publication, real OS/SystemOS policy and desktop startup are still pending.
No new full native arm64e kernel or phone image was built in this step. Hardware
probing and root publication remain disabled by default; no phone retest is
requested. The next integration should combine the verified transport with
real kernel root-media registration and authenticated root-volume inputs before
spending another full native build or requesting a hardware test.
